user.title: Aquagem Pump
user.description: Choose how Home Assistant reaches the pump. Existing RS485/TCP gateways remain supported. Direct serial now supports the validated iSaver C3/D0 profile at 1200-8-N-1 and DM-family / standard Aquagem Modbus RTU at 9600-8-N-1.

tcp.title: RS485/TCP gateway
tcp.description: Connect through a transparent RS485/TCP gateway. Protocol detection is automatic and read-only. WaveShare: TCP Server, port 502, 8N1, Protocol None. Use 1200 baud for iSaver C3/D0 or 9600 baud for DM15 / standard Aquagem Modbus.

serial.title: Direct serial / USB-RS485
serial.description: Select the serial port and pump profile. iSaver C3/D0 uses 1200-8-N-1; Aquagem Modbus RTU uses 9600-8-N-1. For Modbus, enter the slave address as decimal 160–191 or hexadecimal 0xA0–0xBF. The address field is ignored for iSaver.

manual.title: Manual protocol fallback
manual.description: Automatic signature detection did not identify the pump through the TCP gateway. Select a known profile only after checking the gateway serial baud rate. This validation remains read-only.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Aquagem Pump
reconfigure.description: Change the device name or RS485/TCP gateway connection. This alpha keeps the existing transport type unchanged during reconfiguration.

reconfigure_serial.title: Reconfigure Aquagem Pump serial connection
reconfigure_serial.description: Change the device name or serial port. Modbus entries can also change the slave address. The stored pump profile is kept unchanged during reconfiguration.

error.cannot_connect: Could not communicate with the configured gateway/pump.
error.cannot_validate_manual: The selected profile did not return its expected read-only protocol signature. Check the gateway baud rate, RS485 wiring and Modbus address.
error.cannot_validate_serial: The selected serial port opened, but the expected Aquagem protocol signature was not validated. Check RS485 wiring and the selected profile: 1200-8-N-1 for iSaver C3/D0 or 9600-8-N-1 for Aquagem Modbus RTU.
error.invalid_modbus_address: Invalid Modbus address. Enter 160–191 in decimal or 0xA0–0xBF in hexadecimal.
error.endpoint_in_use: This IP address and TCP port are already used by another Aquagem Pump entry.
error.serial_endpoint_in_use: This serial port is already used by another Aquagem Pump entry.

abort.manual_without_gateway: Manual protocol selection requires TCP gateway details first.

init.title: Aquagem Pump options
init.description: Set the polling interval. iSaver C3/D0 devices also expose configurable RPM limits and Home Assistant speed profiles.

error.invalid_speed_step: Speeds must be between 1200 and 2900 rpm in 100 rpm steps.
error.invalid_speed_range: Maximum speed must be greater than minimum speed.
error.profile_out_of_range: All profile speeds must be inside the configured minimum and maximum range.
